title: Less is more: learning what to profile for GPU kernel optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.36576v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models have recently shown strong potential for automatically optimizing GPU kernels, yet their effectiveness depends critically on the hardware information available to the kernel optimization model. Existing systems typically rely on predefined profiling strategies, leaving what to profile largely outside the optimization process. We show that effective profiling is not simply about collecting more information: increasing the number of profiling metrics does not monotonically improve kernel optimization, while the most useful profiling information varies across kernels. Our theoretical analysis further shows that, under such heterogeneous profiling utility, kernel-conditioned selection can outperform any single fixed profiling configuration. translated_title: 少即是多：为GPU内核优化学习需要分析什么
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型最近在自动优化GPU内核方面展现出强大潜力，但其有效性关键取决于内核优化模型所能获取的硬件信息。现有系统通常依赖预定义的性能分析策略，使得“分析什么”这一决策在很大程度上被排除在优化过程之外。我们证明，有效的性能分析并非简单地收集更多信息：增加性能分析指标的数量并不能单调地提升内核优化效果，且最有用的性能分析信息因内核而异。我们的理论分析进一步表明，在这种异构的性能分析效用下，基于内核条件的选择可以优于任何单一固定的性能分析配置。受此观察启发，我们提出了AutoProfiler，一个从优化反馈中学习确定性性能分析树的反馈驱动框架。该树通过迭代方式（摘要在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出AutoProfiler框架，通过从优化反馈中学习确定性的性能分析树，为不同GPU内核自适应地选择最有用的性能分析信息，从而提升大语言模型自动优化GPU内核的效果。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes AutoProfiler, a feedback-driven framework that learns a deterministic profiling tree to adaptively select the most useful profiling information for each GPU kernel, improving LLM-based kernel optimization over fixed profiling strategies.
